description: Coordinates agents, MCP servers, memory, apps, widgets, APIs, and automation workflows.

operating_model.interface: ChatGPT receives natural language commands from the user.
operating_model.router: Veridan Core interprets intent and selects the correct execution path.
operating_model.agents: Specialized executors perform analysis, coding, research, trading preparation, and automation tasks.
operating_model.mcps: MCP servers expose external tools and data sources through standardized bridges.
operating_model.memory: Knowledge, strategies, notes, journals, and project state are persisted for later use.
operating_model.automation: Scheduled or event-triggered workflows coordinate agents and tools.

principles: ChatGPT is the conversational interface, not the whole system.
Veridan Core is the orchestration system.
MCP servers bridge tools and data.
High-risk actions require explicit permission boundaries.
